provenance.training_data: Synthetic Development Dataset (seed 42) loaded from stored CSVs — development/testing only, not operational weather data.
provenance.selection_policy: Final model selected by validation MAE only.
provenance.test_policy: Held-out future test split evaluated exactly once after selection; never used for hyperparameter or model selection.
provenance.preprocessing_policy: Imputer, scaler and one-hot encoder are fitted on training rows only (single sklearn Pipeline fitted inside the train step).
provenance.retraining_policy: Trained once through POST /model/train; rolling-origin retraining is future scope (not in this MVP).

warnings: The selected model's held-out test MAE is worse than reference predictor(s): raw_nwp, precomputed_ai_source. The trained model does NOT improve on these baselines for this lead horizon; the fallback source remains the safer input.
limitations: Synthetic Development Dataset — Development/Testing Only — Not Operational Weather Data — Not an Official Weather Warning.
Single synthetic development dataset and a single 120-day monsoon period (2025-06-01 to 2025-09-28) — one deterministic sample, no cross-validation or multi-season sampling.
No operational validation: these metrics are computed against a synthetic replay dataset and are not IMD/NCMRWF skill scores; they carry no official-warning meaning.
The artifact is trained once from a controlled chronological split via POST /model/train; rolling-origin ML retraining per backtest date is future scope, not part of this MVP.
Only two candidate algorithms are trained (LinearRegression as the baseline, HistGradientBoostingRegressor as the non-linear candidate); no hyperparameter search is performed.
MAE/RMSE on small samples are sensitive to a few extreme rainfall days; read the sample counts together with every metric.
